title: NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust Announces Investor Update Call
summary: NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust ("NXDT") (NYSE: NXDT) announced today that the Company is scheduled to host a conference call on Thursday, December 10, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET (10:00 a.m. CT), to discuss portfolio updates and recent performance.

title: NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust Announces Preferred Share Distribution
summary: NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust (NYSE: NXDT) ("NXDT" or the "Company") today announced a distribution for its 5.50% Series A Cumulative Preferred Shares (NYSE: NXDT PR A) of $0.34375 per share. The distribution will be payable on December 31, 2026, to preferred shareholders of record at the close of business December 23, 2026.

title: NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust Announces Quarterly Distribution
summary: NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust ("NXDT") (NYSE: NXDT) announced today that its board of trustees has declared a quarterly cash distribution of $0.03 per common share of NXDT. The distribution will be payable on December 31, 2026, to shareholders of record on December 15, 2026. About NexPoint Diversified Real Estate Trust (NYSE: NXDT)
